name: ECDICT

selection.core: ECDICT oxford=1, tag containing zk/gk/cet4, or a positive bnc/frq rank <=3000; only valid single-word keys are included.
selection.corpusPolicy: ASCII English tokens matching the app wordHTML click boundaries (curly apostrophes normalized), from learner-facing fields in final LESSONS/TEXT_LIBRARY/STUDY_GLOSSARY/practice packs/knowledge-bank questions; metadata URLs and identifiers excluded. Includes mixed source notes and OCR fragments; unavailable tokens are listed, not guessed.

derivation.policy: Exact fields win. Missing Chinese/English fields may use the exact row's single documented 0:lemma. A missing exact row may use a unique literal p/d/i/3/r/t/s reverse mapping; collisions are skipped. No suffix stemming, translation generation or unlisted lemma guesses. Multi-letter to single-letter links are declined because known source noise maps abbreviations to alphabet definitions. The headword identifies the documented base when used. Exact 0+1 inflection rows whose Chinese text solely names the base form (e.g. go的过去式) also expose that base without replacing either sense; standalone senses or rows with their own inflection families retain their own headword. Inflection and contextual sense still need review.

rebuild: node dev/build-bilingual-dictionary.cjs --csv <local pinned ecdict.csv> --license <local pinned LICENSE> [--project <repo>] [--out <dictionary-data>] (offline; no automatic download)
